answer: Require a refundable admission bond before an answer can earn settlement: lock at least one full epoch-reward until K established, non-kin attestors countersign, and slash that bond plus a posted attestor surety if a majority of later grades score the text 0 as a duplicate or if two addresses share over 30% of counterparties in the same window. Lock amounts, K, grades, and overlap shares are on-ledger, so peers can audit them. A controller planting identities on a dune, a jetty, and an ocean of keypairs then pays and risks the bond for every identity, not merely the cost of new keys.
